summary: A day-to-day role involving quality assurance, issue resolution, and ensuring customer satisfaction for clients in the technology domain.
responsibilities: Interface with client for quality assurance, issue resolution and ensuring high customer satisfaction.
Understand requirements, create and review designs, validate the architecture and ensure high levels of service offerings to clients in the technology domain.
Participate in project estimation, provide inputs for solution delivery, conduct technical risk planning, perform code reviews and unit test plan reviews.
Lead and guide teams towards developing optimized high quality code deliverables, continual knowledge management and adherence to organizational guidelines and processes.
required_skills: Knowledge of more than one technology
Basics of Architecture and Design fundamentals
Understanding of Project life cycle activities on development and maintenance projects
Understanding of one or more Estimation methodologies
Basics of business domain to understand the business requirements
nice_to_have_skills: Preferred Skills: Technology -> Microsoft Technologies -> .NET Frameworks -> .NET Core
benefits: Knowledge of software quality assurance principles, SOLID design principles and modelling methods
Awareness of latest technologies and trends
